content.body: Business problem, G2G capability and business value, one row per solution area.
bullets: Run HR day to day (Attendance, Leave, Payroll): Month-end HR work takes too long. Value: One live attendance record; Payroll built from real attendance; HR verifies before payment.

Know and grow skills (Competency management, KASBA framework, Gap assessment): No clear picture of skills and gaps. Value: A common scale for skills; Start from a ready library; Training needs based on evidence.
Learning and talent (Learning (LMS), Talent): Training and appraisals are not joined up. Value: HR sees progress and certificates; A clear appraisal process; One flow from joining to leaving.

Reports, tasks and access (Reports and analytics, Tasks, Organisation and access): No one clear view, and the wrong access. Value: One place for reports; A clear owner for every task; Each role sees only what it should.

content.body: Straight answers, using only what is documented.
bullets: What will it cost? Say: Pricing has not been fixed, so I will not quote a number. Let us agree the modules and the number of people, and I will bring a written proposal by an agreed date. (Basis: Portfolio: pricing is "To fill". Docs: pricing is TBD.)

Who else uses it? Say: None of the G2G modules is in production at a client yet. That is why we propose a small pilot, and I will not quote client numbers I cannot back. (Basis: Portfolio: no offer is "Live with client". No testimonial or client count is documented.)

What is ready today? Say: Attendance, leave, salary structure, skills library and gap assessment are built. The monthly payroll run, courses linked to skills, and AI assistance are still being completed. (Basis: v1 docs status and the portfolio readiness list.)

content.body: Value proposition: your people, skills and learning on one platform. Attendance, leave and payroll. Talent and appraisals. Skills and training. Tasks and access control.
bullets: Next step 1: Agree the one or two modules and the number of people
Next step 2: Run the pilot on your own data
Next step 3: You choose the success measures
Next step 4: We send a written proposal by an agreed date
This is our proposed approach, not a documented product feature. Pricing is not fixed, so no number is quoted.
